title: Cap. VII close: same foundations — refute mixed, then confirm ours; Cap. VIII ahead
pass_a_gloss: Now by what arguments they prop up this their opinion, who fetch this reprobation or passing by from foresighted demerits, or from unbelief and final perseverance in the same, let us hear. Nor is there need that the arguments of the Jesuits and of the Arminians be accurately distinguished: for they rest on plainly the same foundations. As therefore they have offered themselves to us in reading, we will propose them mixed. But these having been refuted, it will be to be approached unto the confirmation of our opinion.
pass_b_english: Now let us hear by what arguments they prop this view — those who fetch reprobation or praeterition from foresighted demerits, or from unbelief and final perseverance in it. No need to split Jesuit and Arminian arguments carefully: they rest on plainly the same foundations. As they met us in reading, we will set them out mixed. Once refuted, we will turn to confirming our own opinion.
source_text: Jam quibus argumentis hanc suam sententiam fulciant, qui hanc reprobationem sive praeteritionem a praevisis demeritis, vel infidelitate et perseverantia finali in eadem, arcessunt, audiamus. Neque opus est ut accurate distinguantur argumenta Jesuitarum et Arminianorum: nam iisdem plane fundamentis nituntur. Ut igitur inter legendum se nobis obtulerunt, ea mixtim proponemus. Hisce autem refutatis, ad sententiae nostrae confirmationem erit accedendum.
